Jan-Willem Doornenbal, Risoprint Meerpaaltjes

A two-color riso print of mooring posts and reeds mirrored in water, in a warm pink and a blue that overprint into violet.

Source
Flickr: Jan-Willem Doornenbal, “Risoprint Meerpaaltjes”
Creator
Jan-Willem Doornenbal
Made

Style
Risograph (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Layered, calm, grainy
Evidence
Viewed the 1024 × 577 px Flickr “large” file, a photograph of one sheet. The pink looks warmer and duller than fluorescent ink usually does, possibly because of the camera.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Open license, stored. License: CC-BY-2.0. Rights policy

Context

The Flickr description says: “Vier foto's van paaltjes en riet, gespiegeld in het water.” (Four photos of posts and reeds, mirrored in the water.)

Observed

  • Two inks: a salmon pink and a blue.
  • Where they overlap, the color is violet, especially in the reeds and reflections.
  • The ink is patchy, and paper shows through in streaks.
  • The image fills a long horizontal band with an off-white margin.

Why it belongs

The work depends on overprint: the violet is not an ink but the overlap of two translucent layers.

Borrow

Print the same image in two inks, slightly different in threshold, so the overlap draws the shadows.
